description: PICIC Insurance Limited is a Pakistani general insurer writing all classes of general insurance business. It presents itself as a specialist underwriter that identifies clients' risk exposures and advises on them, backing that with an in-house IT system for underwriting, policy issuance and claims processing. It is a small listed insurer, and its own site gives a paid-up capital of Rs 350 million.
sourceNote: Company website (picicinsurance.com about page: general insurance company dealing with all classes of general insurance, paid-up capital of Rs 350 million, underwriting and claims approach; the management page naming Mr Moiz Ali as managing director and chief executive), read 2026-10-17. No head office address or telephone is published there, so both are null.
